title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: service contract rank and the premium discount
content:
## Scope

This rule of the Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims product line decides whether the contract premium discount applies to the premium of a bound cover.

## Rule

1. The contract discount applies, at the product's contract discount percent, when the cover holder holds an active service contract whose tier rank in the contract charter is at least the product's lowest qualifying rank, and that lowest qualifying rank is not 0.
2. The contract read is the holder's contract in the active status, on any trade lane.
3. A holder with no active contract gets no discount.

## Contract tier ranks

| Service contract | Tier rank |
|---|---|
| AHL Starter Service Contract | 1 |
| AHL Standard Service Contract | 2 |
| AHL Regional Account Contract | 3 |
| AHL Key Account Contract | 4 |
| AHL Global Account Contract | 5 |
| AHL Strategic Partner Contract | 6 |
| No active contract | no discount |

## Truth table

| Product's lowest qualifying rank | Holder's active contract | Rank at least the lowest qualifying rank | Discount |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | any | not tested | None |
| above 0 | none | not tested | None |
| above 0 | held | No | None |
| above 0 | held | Yes | The product's contract discount percent |

## Hypothetical cases (hypothetical lowest qualifying rank of 4)

- The holder's active contract is AHL Regional Account Contract (rank 3): below 4, so no discount.
- The holder's active contract is AHL Key Account Contract (rank 4): at least 4, so the discount applies.
- The holder's only contract with a rank of 6 is not in the active status: it is not read, and with no active contract there is no discount.
